title: Refactor Tests Result
description: Return of the refactor-tests agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the proposed commit subject, how the fix goes about it and the files it changed, which pb checkpoint --step refactor commits as one fix group once the task's tests pass

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: Only a question a human must answer before the work can be trusted, phrased as a question (such as whether to change behaviour to fix an issue, or what to do about an edit that was refused or failed), or an empty string. pb gate eval shows every non-empty one to the human as a doubt. Explanations of your choices go in notes, never here

notes.description: What you want to explain about your choices, in plain words, or an empty string. No gate reads it and it never stops the run

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line, or an empty string when nothing changed

approach.description: One short sentence naming how the fix goes about it, so a retry can be told which approaches were rejected, or empty string when nothing changed

no_change_reason.description: Why nothing needed changing (for example, an earlier fix group already resolved the finding), or an empty string when files changed. It lets pb checkpoint accept a fix that changed nothing without asking the human

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified

renamed.description: Each test this fix renamed or split, so pb selects it by its new name from then on. Leave it out, or empty, when no test name changed. Only with a <test_id> in the prompt

test_id.description: The test_id of the renamed or split test, as the tests artifact gives it

to.description: Its new name, or one entry per test it was split into

test_file.description: The new test_file, only when the test moved to another file
